name: Smartlead
shortDescription: Cold email platform whose SmartAssistant sets up and fixes outreach.
longDescription: Smartlead's site describes SmartAssistant as a personal cold-email AI assistant to set up, run, and fix outreach, plus lead and deliverability products. The page did not list a plan price.
pricingNotes: The site describes SmartAssistant as a cold-email AI assistant. A customer story dollar figure is not a plan price.

strength: Smartlead describes SmartAssistant as a cold-email AI assistant that sets up, runs, and fixes outreach.
